title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel
At
Airalo
, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.
Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.
We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.
Your Next Destination
Location:
Remote.
Contract:
Full-time, permanent.
Benefits:
Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
Languages:
English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.
About The Role
You will own a complex domain of the Network business support systems (BSS) stack as a strategic product area with users, measurable outcomes, technical dependencies, and cross-functional impact. You will define the roadmap, shape the technical direction with engineering and architecture partners, and lead discovery and execution across multiple squads and stakeholder groups.
What You'll Do
Own a BSS domain's strategy and roadmap, linking quarterly outcomes to platform evolution, commercial strategy, regulation, scalability and architecture.
Lead discovery for complex BSS and network-platform problems: frame problems, research stakeholders, analyse operations and market and regulatory inputs, and validate solution options.
Turn ambiguous business, commercial, regulatory and technical needs into product opportunities, decision records and actionable roadmap bets.
Sequence launch-blocking market needs, incumbent-platform migrations, cost reduction and enabling capabilities; publish the rationale.
Define and optimise metrics and KPIs to measure impact, report status and inform decisions.
Own the network-capability interface with Commercial and Partnerships: assess wholesale agreements and international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) sponsorships, their technical benefits and constraints, and which asks warrant reopening a contract.
Write engineering specifications covering the problem, current and target behaviour, interface contracts, migration, rollback and observable acceptance criteria.
Lead cross-squad delivery through epics, product requirements documents, migration plans, acceptance criteria, dependency maps, release sequencing, rollout and rollback plans, and success metrics.
Resolve cross-squad trade-offs and conflicting views of dependencies; document the disagreement and resolution.
Brief senior leaders in plain language on changes, costs, benefits, risks, trade-offs and decisions needed, with analysis and technical detail available.
Partner with Engineering and Solution Architecture to evaluate technical approaches, platform trade-offs, integration patterns, migration, rollback and long-term maintainability.
Influence architecture by clarifying product outcomes, operational constraints, regulatory and data requirements, and customer and partner impact.
What You'll Bring
5–8+ years in product management or product ownership, with proven ownership of complex technical platforms
3+ years in telecom networks, mobile core, MVNO, MVNE, BSS / operations support systems (OSS) or connectivity platforms.
Experience creating and iterating product roadmaps.
Experience facilitating technical product and feature discussions and giving feedback on technical designs.
Experience defining, building and shipping technical products.
Experience collaborating with designers, engineers and QA in an agile environment.
Ability to discuss APIs, data models, integrations, architecture, reliability, observability and migration strategy in depth.
Ability to write a build-versus-buy case a CTO and CFO will accept, and defend it to more senior stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and data-driven decision-making skills.
Experience with agile / scrum methodology.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Nice to have
Platform-side experience at an MNO, MVNO or MVNE, rather than retail-side experience.
Knowledge of eSIM, Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) and MNO / MVNO / MVNE operating models.
Literacy in the GSM Association (GSMA) eSIM specifications SGP.21 (architecture) and SGP.22 (remote provisioning), and wholesale roaming and interconnect specifications.
Experience with Jira, Confluence or Notion, Figma, QuickSight, Tableau, Dovetail, Google, AI tools, Lightdash and BigQuery.
Coding experience or technical knowledge of coding languages.
Compensation
At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍
This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:
📍 UK: £87,600 – £131,400
📍 Ireland: €81,600 – €122,400
📍 Western/Northern Europe: €61,600 – €156,302
📍 Southern Europe: €56,800 – €125,400
📍 Central & Eastern Europe: €61,762 – €104,400
📍 South-Eastern Europe/Balkans: €55,523 – €99,898
Your Home Destination 🛫
At Airalo, we use localized market data, so your compensation band depends on where you’re based. You can learn more about our compensation philosophy in our
public handbook
.
Most of our hires come in within the first half of the band, which leaves you room to grow, and you’ll see exactly what that looks like from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed the role’s requirements, we’re happy to discuss going higher.
We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨
Additional Information
Why People Join Us
We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.
Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.
As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.
Before You Hit Apply
By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here:
www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy
We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

title: Product Manager - AI Investing
description:
About
BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.
This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
What We're Looking For
Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.
People who launch features and then stop caring.
PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
Austria.
We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
Austria.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About
BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.
What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end
— outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering
— system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs
across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs
— licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place
— define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates
— build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership
— significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation
— solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain
— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement
— hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have
— engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
Spain
. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
Spain
.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Product Owner
About Makai
Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. is seeking a Product Owner with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and communication. .

title: Product Manager - Security
description:
About
Nebius
:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation.
Your responsibilities will include:
1. Product Management
Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products.
Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes.
Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything.
2. Customer-facing communications
Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status.
In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO.
Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements.
3.
Competitive analysis and market research
Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications.
Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market.
Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards).
4. Certification and audit support, service ownership
Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements.
Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform.
Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives.
5. Cross-functional collaboration
Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging.
Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports).
Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally.
We expect you to have:
3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives.
Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value.
Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences).
Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams.
Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions.
Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals.
It will be an added bonus if you have:
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.
About Nebius
Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.
Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).
Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.
Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.
If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Product Manager
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

What you will do?

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Ads personalization & targeting across Glance surfaces
  • Generate insights that reshape targeting strategy and surface new growth levers. Build products that help identify high-value targeting opportunities and next best actions across audiences, contextual signals, products, categories, and surfaces.
  • Translate business goals into ML problem statements: define features, labels, training data, and success metrics for models to deliver advertiser KPIs
  • Act as the primary product stakeholder for experimentation design, metrics definition, and guardrails spanning engagement, ad metrics and advertiser KPIs. Build the feedback loop from auction and ad-serving outcomes back into model training and targeting strategy
  • Work closely with Tech and ML teams to shape ads recommendation framework and create execution plans to ensure timely delivery of high-quality outputs
  • Enhance monetization efficiency through ML algorithms such as dynamic floor pricing 

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in AdTech, AI/ML products, recommendation systems, decisioning platforms, or digital advertising.
  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including targeting, ad serving, auctions, bidding, pricing, yield optimization, and advertiser KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of ML-driven targeting, ranking/recommendation, audience segmentation, contextual signals, and personalization, with the ability to translate business problems into ML problem statements.
  • Highly data-driven, with experience defining metrics, designing experiments, and building feedback loops to optimize both user engagement and advertiser outcomes.
  • Strong product sense with experience owning strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and end-to-end execution for complex, data-intensive products.
  • Comfortable partnering deeply with Engineering, ML/Data Science, Ads, and Business teams to drive decisions and deliver high-quality products at scale. 

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

About Accelerate:
Accelerate is InMobi’s AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate’s agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.

About the role:
You will own the heart of Accelerate: the experience that turns a brand’s goals into a live, running campaign. That includes campaign creation, the chat interface advertisers use to work with our agents, and AI creative generation. You will make that one experience work for very different customers: an SMB owner launching a first campaign, an agency running dozens of client accounts, a mid-size advertiser scaling spend, and an enterprise team with approval processes. You will also take Accelerate beyond our own
app, through APIs for companies that want our capabilities without onboarding, and through bundled offerings inside SMB-heavy platforms such as Stripe, Razorpay and Shopify. This is a senior, high-ownership role. The product is agentic and LLM-driven, so you will shape not just screens but how the agent reasons, what it produces, and how we measure whether it is good.


What you will own:

  • Campaign creation, chat and creative generation. The hero surface where an advertiser’s brand blueprint becomes a live campaign. You own the end-to-end flow, the conversation design, and the quality of what the agent produces.
  • Segment-specific journeys. One product that adapts to SMBs, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise clients. Includes multi-account workflows for agencies and controls, approvals and roles for enterprise.
  • AI quality for your surfaces. Prompt and RAG design for brand context, eval sets that define “good” for a campaign plan or a creative, and quality gates that releases must pass. The Agentic AI pod owns platform-wide autonomy tiers and guardrails; you own whether your surfaces produce the right output.
  • APIs and headless access. A public API so partners and larger customers can create and manage campaigns without using our UI. You own the developer experience, docs and pricing model, working with engineering on the design.
  • Embedded distribution. Accelerate as a bundled offering inside platforms such as Stripe, Razorpay and Shopify. You shape the product side of these partnerships: the in-partner experience, account linking and the value proposition, working with the business team on the deals.
  • Metrics. Time from brief to live campaign, campaign launch rate, creative acceptance rate, eval pass rates, and adoption by segment and by channel (app, API, partner).

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years of product management, with at least 2 years owning a B2B product used by multiple customer segments.
  • You have shipped an LLM-powered product to real users in production, not just a pilot or demo. You have dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost and quality regressions.
  • Hands-on understanding of RAG, prompt design, agentic workflows and evals. You have written eval sets yourself and used them to decide whether something ships.
  • Strong design sense. You can show work where you shaped the experience in detail, and you partner with designers as a peer.
  • You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and a wide scope. You can keep the hero surface moving while building the API and partnership tracks alongside it.
  • Clear written communication with engineers, designers, business partners and customers. 

Strong pluses

  • Experience in martech, adtech or performance marketing products, or time as a performance marketer yourself.
  • Built or owned a public API, developer platform or partner app (for example, a Shopify app or a payment-platform integration).
  • Shipped a product that serves both self-serve SMBs and enterprise or agency accounts from one codebase.
  • Experience with generative creative: image, video or ad copy generation with brand-safety checks.
  • A portfolio or public writing showing your product and design thinking.

How we work
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

  • Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
  • Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
  • Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
  • Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
  • Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

About the role:
You will build Accelerate’s payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

What you will own:

  • Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
  • Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
  • Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
  • Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
  • Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
  • Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
  • Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate’s success framework depends on your system.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
  • You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
  • Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
  • Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
  • Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
  • You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.
    Strong pluses
  • You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
  • Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
  • Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
  • Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
  • Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

About the Role:
You will own Accelerate’s growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment. 

What you will own:

  • Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what “activated” means for each.
  • Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.

  • Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
  • Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
  • Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
  • Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.


What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
  • Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
  • A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
  • Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
  • Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
  • You work AI-native (see “How we work” below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.

Strong pluses:

  • Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
  • Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
  • Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
  • Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
  • Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.

How we work:
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

  • Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
  • Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
  • Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
  • Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
  • Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

title: Senior Product Manager, Expenses
description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

Processing a single expense is becoming commoditized. Managing expenses across an enterprise is not. Companies must distribute cards broadly while controlling risk, documenting transactions, enforcing policy, routing approvals, preparing for audit, and producing ERP-ready records.

As Staff Product Manager for Expenses, you will turn that complexity into one intelligent system for employees, managers, finance teams, and accountants. You will lead the strategy across documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and accounting readiness.

You will align specialized product teams across Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, and GTM. Using AI and automation, you will eliminate routine work, surface meaningful exceptions, help finance teams close faster, and build capabilities that win major enterprise relationships.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end strategy for enterprise expense management.
  • Unify documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and ERP readiness.
  • Define the systems, data models, configurations, and controls complex enterprises require.
  • Align specialized product teams around the complete expense lifecycle.
  • Use AI to automate routine work and route only judgment-heavy exceptions to people.
  • Partner with Design to make sophisticated enterprise workflows intuitive.
  • Align Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, Sales, and Customer Success around enterprise outcomes.
  • Own adoption, workflow completion, manual-work reduction, close speed, retention, and software revenue.

Requirements

  • A track record of leading complex enterprise workflow or systems products.
  • Strong technical fluency in backend systems, data models, integrations, and configurable product architecture.
  • Experience supporting extensive customer permutations without sacrificing usability.
  • Ability to unite multiple domains under one strategy and operating model.
  • Strong customer and Design judgment across employee, manager, finance, and accounting experiences.
  • Concrete judgment about where AI should remove work and where human review matters.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and an understanding of how product capabilities affect enterprise sales and adoption.
  • Expense management experience is preferred; accounting, ERP, procurement, compliance, or adjacent enterprise-software experience can substitute.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.
